violation_type.title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))
violation_type.short_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction
violation_type.typical_finding: The provider was missing five of the additional training content courses.

finding_variants.text: The provider was missing five of the additional training content courses.

The primary caregiver was lacking the following training topics:  Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic .

One household member who is counted in ratio did not have required training for Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic.
Primary caregiver was missing the madatory annual trainings for specifcally this section.
The training records were observed to be lacking specific health and safety trainings that are required to be completed annually.
In review of assistant caregiver's records, there is no proof of training in food allergy, emergency preparedness and handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials available for review.
